notes.title: Tank Factory First Year Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear Tank Factory Workers![/b]

It has been a year now since we started to build the greatest tanks the human kind has ever seen. The tank factory has seen numerous improvements, numerous new and better models of tanks and also numerous disasters, such as bombings and battles on the [b][i]war front of love[/i][/b].

As an anniversary gift for all the diligent tank factory workers we are releasing Panzer Hearts as free to play – you can now join the ranks of the tank builders for free! We only wish you leave a review on our Steam page to let all the workers of the world now that now is the time to unite our forces in the battle for freedom!

Yours,
Hans
Tank Factory Sergeant
Precision Assembler

notes.title: Tank Factory Autumn Update
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32567280/d9fbf31826066b999e9f6770d1aadf2f98d89870.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32567280/34a731c04cc1cf000c2b2f8d171b360e3116649e.png[/img][/url]
[h1][b]Hello Tank Factory Workers![/b][/h1]

Much has happened in the Tank Factory lately. We have listened to the critique and made the adjustments some of our fellow workers have addressed. Biggest update is concerning the tank building scenes where the drag and drop mechanic is completely re-edited.

Enjoy!


[i]Yours,
Hans, 
Tank Factory Sergeant
Precision Assembler[/i]

notes.title: Major update in the tank factory!
notes.content:
[h1]Major update in the tank factory![/h1]

There has been over 10 commits and over 100 fixes to the code since the release and the factory is running so smooth you could mistake it to an electric car. You won’t even see it coming until it hits you. Very much unlike a Tiger I. 

[b]Enjoy![/b]


[i]Yours,
Hans, 
Tank Factory Precision Assemble[/i]

notes.title: Tank Factory Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32567280/6e1790ea6496e837b5a7f1a6018afe417ba76d83.png[/img]
The tank factory has been running on full steam after the release – it almost feels like it’s 1944 all over again! We want to express our gratitude to our community for helping us find those nasty bugs crawling on the factory walls and causing all kinds of sanitary problems. It feels good to work in a clean environment.
Yours,
Hans, Tank Factory Precision Assembler

Fixed issues:
- multiple typos
- a problem with the Astrid route achievement not unlocking
- bug with the hint system
